skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — make this photo dance to a hip-hop beat — and get dancing video clips back...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Dance AI.

- Instantly animates uploaded photos into dance videos using cloud AI.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC files up to 200MB; generates 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple setup: automatic anonymous token generation and session handling.
- Core actions include uploading images, generating dance videos, checking credits, and exporting finished clips.
- Designed for creators who want quick, realistic dance video results without complex editing.
